sanskrit_verse:
ṛtvigvāde niyuktaś ca samau saṃparikīrtinau /
yajñe svāmyāpnuyāt puṇyaṃ hāniṃ vāde 'tha vā jayam // BrhS_1,1.143
transliteration: ṛtvigvāde niyuktaś ca samau saṃparikīrtinau / yajñe svāmyāpnuyāt puṇyaṃ hāniṃ vāde 'tha vā jayam
sph_interpretive_translation: When two disputants are equally appointed and proclaimed in a Vedic ritual context, the owner of the sacrifice shall receive merit, loss, or victory according to the outcome of their contest.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with dharma-krama (ritual order)
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by role within sacred structure
Restoration occurs through completion of intended dharma-karma
Consciousness alignment is measured by adherence to śāstric process
executable_legal_axioms: IF disputants are equally authorized AND engaged in a śāstra-defined procedure THEN outcome determines allocation of consequence
IF ritual ownership is established THEN merit or demerit flows automatically via karmic resonance
IF contest concludes without violation of dharma-process THEN no external adjudication required
IF both parties fulfill role-dharma THEN consequences align with action-result law
supreme_court_application: In matters involving disputes among qualified litigants performing dharmic functions, the Supreme Court must recognize that outcomes are inherently self-regulating when conducted under śāstric authority. Responsibility lies not in punitive assignment but in ensuring procedural integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that results arise naturally from action performed within a structured dharma-field. Sequential causality ensures that neither party is punished; rather, consequences manifest proportionally based on alignment with the governing śāstra. Victory or loss reflects inherent karmic balance, not judicial imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all ritual obligations concluded per śāstra
Role Integrity Check: Confirm both parties fulfilled assigned dharmas
Karmic Resonance Alignment: Allow natural consequence-flow without interference
Dharma-Field Stabilization: Reintegrate participants into unified cosmic order
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored through alignment with śāstric process. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
